Title: A Flux-to-AI Discovery Framework Reveals Carbon-Regulated Intermittent Non-Canonical Nitrification in Achromobacter xylosoxidans
Summary: Builds genome-scale metabolic and machine-learning models across Achromobacter xylosoxidans genomes and uses a flux-to-AI framework to map carbon-regulated intermittent non-canonical nitrification.

Title: Critical review of artificial intelligence in synthetic biology: DBTL cycle applications, challenges, and design rules for microbial strain engineering
Summary: Reviews how machine learning, deep learning, and language models are applied across the DBTL cycle for microbial strain engineering, including metabolic pathway optimization and multi-omics analysis.

Title: Synergistic integration of large language models and knowledge graphs for intelligent metabolic pathway design in food synthetic biology
Summary: Presents a framework that combines large language models with knowledge graphs to design metabolic pathways in food synthetic biology when biochemical databases are incomplete.

Title: Harnessing Yeast Mitochondria for the Sustainable Production of High-Value Chemicals
Summary: Reviews compartmentalized mitochondrial pathway engineering in yeast to isolate biosynthetic routes from cytoplasmic competition and produce high-value chemicals.

Title: NAD⁺-driven modular multi-enzyme cascade system enables the in vitro synthesis of 3-hydroxypropionic acid from glucose
Summary: Designs a modular cell-free multi-enzyme cascade that converts glucose to 3-hydroxypropionic acid using only the NAD⁺/NADH redox pair instead of costly NADPH.

Title: An anoxygenic photosynthesis-inspired dual biohybrid for light-enhanced chemical production
Summary: Builds a dual biohybrid in Escherichia coli that couples extracellular light-harvesting polymers with intracellular CdS nanoparticles to enhance malate production under illumination.

Title: Rational design of chimeric polyhydroxyalkanoate synthases suggests a conserved N-terminal domain-to-LID region network influencing 3HHx incorporation and granule morphology
Summary: Uses bioinformatics-guided domain swapping to design chimeric class I PHA synthases that retain activity and 3-hydroxyhexanoate incorporation while producing single-granule morphology.

Title: Development of a high-throughput proteome sample preparation workflow based on efficient protein extraction to empower rational design of yeast cell factories
Summary: Develops a high-throughput protein-extraction and proteome sample-preparation workflow to support rational design of yeast cell factories.

Title: Recent Advances in Fungal Cell Factories for Sustainable Bioenergy and Biomaterials Developments: Challenges and Future Directions
Summary: Reviews fungal cell factories for bioenergy and biomaterials, including metabolic-map-guided pathway modulation and remaining strain-engineering challenges.

Title: Herbicide degradation is driven by communication-mediated division of labor in synthetic communities
Summary: Constructs synthetic communities that degrade multiple herbicides through quorum-sensing-mediated metabolic division of labor and tests bioremediation in maize pot trials.

Title: Hybrid living materials hosting Pseudomonas biofilms for continuous biotransformation of cyclohexanol to adipic acid
Summary: Hosts Pseudomonas biofilms in hybrid living materials for continuous biotransformation of cyclohexanol to adipic acid.
